cases.name: copies a file bigger than the buffer
cases.cmd: "$BIN" big.txt copy.txt && cmp big.txt copy.txt && echo same

cases.name: empties an existing destination
cases.setup: echo new > src.txt; echo 'old content that is much longer than the new one' > dst.txt

cases.name: missing source: status 1, nothing created
cases.cmd: "$BIN" nope.txt out.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"; test -e out.txt && echo created || echo absent

cases.name: missing source: error text on stderr
